name: Samurai
design: Disciplined Japanese swordsman, expressive mature face under a dark blue kabuto helmet, midnight navy and burgundy lamellar armour, ivory scarf, katana held in two hands, short red sash. Distinct from the red bow archer.
attack: two handed katana cut to the right
cast: katana raised for a precise overhead parry and riposte

name: Kunoichi
design: Agile adult female ninja, long dark hair in high ponytail, burgundy and purple fitted shinobi outfit, ivory leg wraps, red scarf, small curved kunai in each hand, compact athletic silhouette, face visible.
attack: quick dual kunai stab to the right
cast: throw a small shuriken right then recover

name: Fire Wizard
design: Expressive adult male fire wizard, swept auburn hair, long burgundy coat with gold borders over charcoal robes, pointed red wizard hat, wooden staff with amber crystal, leather belt and boots.
attack: point the amber staff right to cast a fire spell without large effects
cast: lift the staff with free hand outstretched, channel then lower

name: Paladin
design: Noble adult male holy knight, silver white plate armour with ornate gold trim, ivory and royal blue tabard, short golden hair, heavy golden mace and kite shield marked with a sun. Heroic readable face.
attack: heavy mace strike to the right
cast: raise shield and mace in a protective blessing

name: Cleric
design: Kind but determined adult female battle priest, chestnut hair, ivory hood and white robes, teal stole and gold trim, leather boots, compact steel mace and small prayer book at belt, readable warm face.
attack: swing the short mace to the right
cast: open prayer book and extend a hand in a healing blessing

name: Minotaur
design: Massive bull headed anthropomorphic warrior, warm dark brown fur, broad cream horns, expressive bull face, deep red leather straps, gold nose ring, steel shoulder armour and enormous double headed battleaxe. Compact heroic monster proportions, broad muscular build, NOT a human.
attack: two handed huge axe chop right
cast: lower horns then charge one step right and recover

name: Peasant
design: Resourceful young adult Japanese peasant militia fighter, straw jingasa hat, simple ochre padded tunic, navy trousers, white leg bindings, rope belt, wooden long spear. Cheerful determined face, humble practical costume.
attack: thrust spear horizontally right
cast: brace spear low in a defensive formation

name: Ninja Monk
design: Athletic adult martial monk, bald head with small dark topknot, large wooden prayer beads, saffron wrap over dark indigo shinobi trousers, white fist wraps, bare forearms and sandals. No weapon, strong compact fighting stance.
attack: punch punch and forward kick to the right
cast: bring hands together then palm strike right

name: Wanderer
design: Mysterious adult travelling alchemist mage, weathered green hooded cloak, cream scarf, leather satchel and belt full of colourful potion flasks, auburn hair and goggles on forehead, short crooked walking staff. Clearly an alchemist.
attack: throw a small potion flask to the right
cast: lift a potion vial then extend it forward

name: Lightning Mage
design: Quick energetic adult lightning sorceress, silver white hair, deep purple blue robes with gold lightning patterns, short pointed violet hat, staff tipped with small blue crystal, bright cyan eyes, expressive confident face.
attack: jab lightning staff forward to the right
cast: raise crystal staff and sweep free hand outward

name: Kitsune
design: Elegant adult female fox spirit, clearly visible orange fox ears and large fluffy cream tipped orange tails, long auburn hair, ornate white and crimson Japanese kimono, violet obi sash, gold bell charms, closed paper fan. Expressive human face with sly smile.
attack: sweep the folded fan toward the right
cast: open fan before face then flourish it outward

name: Karasu Tengu
design: Small agile crow tengu, black feathered bird head with obvious dark beak and bright gold eye, black wings, purple yamabushi robes, red scarf, tall geta sandals, curved short sword. A crow person, NOT a human wearing a mask.
attack: quick curved sword slash to the right
cast: spread wings and make a diving sword thrust right

name: Yamabushi Tengu
design: Imposing mature mountain tengu, traditional red long nosed expressive face, large white beard, black feather wings, ornate ivory and dark red mountain priest robes, gold prayer beads, tall black hat, large leaf shaped war fan.
attack: strike right with the broad leaf fan
cast: sweep the fan upward and spread the wings

name: Werewolf
design: Powerful anthropomorphic wolf warrior, silver grey fur, long wolf muzzle, pointed ears, gold eyes, dark blue leather torn trousers and bracers, massive clawed hands and feet, no weapon, expressive fierce wolf face. Clearly a wolf monster NOT human.
attack: powerful claw swipe to the right
cast: crouch, throw back wolf head and howl then recover

name: Satyr
design: Playful adult male forest satyr, curly chestnut hair, small curved ram horns, pointed ears and expressive smiling face, furred goat legs with cloven hooves, green vest and purple sash, wooden pan pipes, rustic leather belt.
attack: short forward hoof kick toward the right
cast: raise pan pipes and play with both hands

name: Gorgon
design: Regal female serpent gorgon, pale olive skin, expressive fierce human face, living emerald snake hair, bronze gold scale breastplate and purple silk, long curling emerald snake tail INSTEAD OF LEGS, jade snake staff. Keep clearly snake bodied silhouette.
attack: point jade staff and gaze to the right
cast: raise snake staff and spread free hand in a petrifying gesture

name: Samurai Commander
design: Imposing mature samurai general, heavily plated black and scarlet gold edged armour, magnificent gold crescent kabuto helmet, visible stern moustached face, broad shoulders, crimson cape, back mounted vertical sashimono battle banner, long nodachi sword. More ornate and bulkier than normal samurai.
attack: sweep long nodachi sword right
cast: plant the battle banner at his side and raise sword

name: Druid
design: Adult female forest druid, long copper red hair, small antler crown and leaves, emerald robe and brown leather bodice, cream fur shoulder cape, wooden staff with leafy spiral and small emerald, leather boots, warm expressive face.
attack: point the leafy staff to the right
cast: raise both arms with staff in a summoning gesture

name: Barbarian
design: Broad muscular adult male barbarian, wild red hair and thick beard, bare tattooed arms and chest, fur mantle, leather harness and bronze belt, dark wool trousers and heavy fur boots, enormous steel two handed axe. Compact powerful heroic proportions.
attack: furious two handed axe chop right
cast: raise axe overhead and roar then return to guard

name: Ranger
design: Adult female woodland ranger, long brown hair, deep green hooded cloak and leather armour, gold clasp, tan leggings and high boots, simple elegant wooden longbow, back quiver and belt snares. Clearly medieval forest archer, distinct from the samurai archer.
attack: draw bow to cheek, release arrow right, lower bow
cast: kneel briefly to set a small trap then rise

name: Warlock
design: Sinister adult male warlock, pale readable face with silver hair, deep violet hooded robes with crimson lining and silver trim, dark leather gloves, tall black staff crowned with a small violet skull crystal, occult tome hanging from belt.
attack: point skull staff to the right
cast: open occult tome with one hand and raise staff

name: Illusionist
design: Charismatic adult male illusionist, theatrical purple longcoat with teal lining and gold filigree, feathered violet tricorn, silver half mask leaving expressive mouth visible, white gloves, short elegant wand and a set of cards at belt, slim graceful silhouette.
attack: thrust wand to the right
cast: fan playing cards then sweep wand in an arc

name: Gunslinger
design: Rugged adult female fantasy gunslinger, auburn braid, wide brown hat, long burgundy duster, ivory shirt and leather gun belts, steel revolver in each hand, tall brown boots, confident expressive face. Antique flintlock fantasy firearms, no modern tactical equipment.
attack: aim and fire one pistol to the right then recover
cast: draw second pistol and fire both forward

name: Shambler
design: Hunched undead zombie hero, grey green decayed skin, messy sparse dark hair, vacant pale eyes and expressive slack face, torn brown tunic and purple ragged trousers, exposed bandaged ribs, bare clawed hands, mismatched boots. Charming dark fantasy monster, no gore.
attack: lurch and rake claws to the right
cast: hunch and reach down with both arms then rise

name: Rifle Bot
design: Compact fantasy clockwork rifle automaton, steel and brass segmented armour, single bright cyan eye in squat helmet head, navy enamel panels, exposed bronze joints and short mechanical legs, integrated long steel rifle held in mechanical hands. Clearly a robot, NOT a human.
attack: aim rifle and fire right with shoulder recoil
cast: brace rifle and fire a short burst right

name: Mercenary
design: Grizzled mature human sellsword, scarred stubbled readable face, short dark hair with grey streak, worn leather armour and steel chainmail, charcoal travelling cloak, notched broadsword, coin purse and leather boots. Grounded veteran distinct from the bright blond Soldier.
attack: practical broadsword slash to the right
cast: point sword at foe then make a forceful thrust

name: Mummy
design: Ancient mummy hero, tightly wrapped aged ivory linen bandages, large glowing amber eyes beneath wraps, ornate turquoise and gold collar and wrist bands, trailing loose bandage strips, hunched human silhouette with bare wrapped hands. Egyptian fantasy, no gore.
attack: lash a bandaged arm toward the right
cast: extend both arms with curled bandage strips then retract

name: Buccaneer
design: Dashing adult male pirate, red bandana under brown tricorn, expressive stubbled face, open ivory shirt, red sash and weathered brown shortcoat, curved silver cutlass in right hand and iron grappling hook left, knee boots and belts.
attack: cutlass slash to the right
cast: swing grappling hook forward to the right

name: Wolf Bard
design: Anthropomorphic grey wolf minstrel, expressive wolf muzzle and ears, friendly gold eyes, burgundy feathered cap, forest green and cream travelling doublet, leather boots, fluffy tail, polished wooden lute held in both hands. Clearly a wolf person with a musical instrument.
attack: strum lute firmly while facing right
cast: raise lute and play a flourish with a lively stance

name: Beastmaster
design: Wild adult female beastmaster, dark skin and expressive face with blue warpaint, dark braided hair, fur trimmed brown leather armour, feathers and bone charms, wolf tooth necklace, coiled leather whip and small curved hunting knife, rugged boots.
attack: crack whip toward the right
cast: raise whip and call the pack with free hand

name: Kraken Mate
design: Broad squid headed sailor monster, purple squid head with obvious long tentacle beard and large yellow eyes, navy blue sailor jacket with brass buttons, burgundy sash, heavy leather trousers and sea boots, iron harpoon held forward. Clearly cephalopod humanoid, no human face.
attack: thrust harpoon to the right
cast: raise harpoon and extend tentacle beard forward

name: Lancer
design: Mounted adult lancer knight riding a compact sturdy BROWN ARMOURED HORSE, steel plate and blue plume helmet with visible face, royal blue saddle cloth and brown leather tack, long silver tipped lance held forward. Show entire horse, rider and lance in every frame; mounted cavalry silhouette.
attack: horse braces while rider thrusts lance to the right
cast: horse rears slightly while rider raises lance then settles

name: Reaper
design: Dark hooded spectral reaper, shadowed skull face with small violet glowing eyes, tattered charcoal and purple layered robes, bony hands, large curved steel scythe on dark wooden shaft, floating robe hem and no visible feet. Expressive sinister fantasy mascot proportions.
attack: sweep curved scythe toward the right
cast: raise scythe and extend bony free hand to harvest souls

name: Time Witch
design: Adult female time witch, long silver hair and expressive violet eyes, ornate indigo and gold robes, tall crooked pointed witch hat, gold clock face amulet, staff topped with a small golden hourglass, leather ankle boots and clockwork belt charms.
attack: point hourglass staff right
cast: raise hourglass staff and turn free hand in a circular gesture

name: Arc Blade
design: Sleek humanoid clockwork sword robot, silver black segmented armour with brass joints and cyan circuit inlays, compact enclosed helmet with glowing cyan visor, violet short cape, broad blue edged steel energy sword. Clearly mechanical, no human skin.
attack: slash the steel energy sword toward the right
cast: charge the sword close to chest then thrust right

name: Dread Pirate
design: Undead pirate captain, expressive skeletal face with tiny green glowing eyes, elaborate black feathered tricorn, tattered long black coat with gold trim, crimson sash, rusty cutlass, small powder keg attached to belt, tall sea boots, dark green accents.
attack: slash rusty cutlass toward the right
cast: lift a small powder keg then toss it toward the right

name: Siege Bot
design: Massive squat fantasy siege automaton, riveted gunmetal and brass armoured torso, broad mechanical shoulders, crimson enamel panels, single amber optic in compact mechanical head, integrated heavy cannon arm, stout piston legs. Clearly a bulky robot, no human skin.
attack: brace cannon arm and fire to the right with heavy recoil
cast: lower stabiliser legs and anchor into siege stance then rise

name: High Priestess
design: Regal adult female high priestess, long golden hair and serene expressive face, elaborate ivory and gold layered robes, tall mitre headdress, small gold halo, staff topped with golden eight pointed star, red gemstone belt and ivory shoes. More ornate than Cleric.
attack: direct golden star staff to the right
cast: raise star staff and extend free hand in resurrection blessing

name: Queen Dragoon
design: Regal adult female dragon knight, long teal hair, expressive fierce face under horned dragon crest helm, ornate teal and gold dragon scale plate armour, small leathery dragon wings on back, purple waist cape, long silver tipped lance, armoured boots. Human dragon knight, not a full dragon.
attack: powerful lance thrust to the right
cast: spread dragon wings and raise lance for a jumping strike

name: Juggernaut
design: Huge hulking iron armoured knight, enormous riveted dark steel plate, brass edges, tiny enclosed helmet with amber slit, giant steel gauntlet fists, broad barrel torso and squat heavy boots, dark burgundy cloth underneath. No handheld weapon; fists are the weapons.
attack: slam a giant iron fist to the right
cast: raise both fists and slam downward toward ground

name: Great Sage
design: Wise elderly male mage, long white beard and expressive kindly eyes, deep blue star patterned robes, broad pointed blue wizard hat with gold band, gnarled wooden staff topped with a small golden star orb, book at belt and brown shoes.
attack: point gnarled star staff to the right
cast: raise star staff overhead and open the free palm

name: Demon Swordsman
design: Adult male demon swordsman, dark red skin, small black horns, expressive sharp face with red eyes, swept black hair, black spiked plate armour with crimson trim, torn dark cape, jagged black greatsword with narrow red edge. Clearly a horned demon warrior.
attack: two handed jagged greatsword cut to the right
cast: hold sword near chest then thrust it forward in a blood pact pose

name: Tyrant
design: Imposing mature tyrannical human warlord, stern expressive face with dark beard, spiked iron crown, ornate black and gold heavy plate, long crimson royal cape with white fur collar, gold sceptre spear in one hand, broad steel boots. Regal dark king silhouette.
attack: thrust sceptre spear toward the right
cast: raise sceptre and point an accusing free hand toward foe
